questions.question: Who has been appointed as Director (Refineries) at Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL)?

The correct answer is __**Arvind Kumar**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__

__
 
• **Currently serving as the Managing Director & CEO of Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited** (CPCL), Kumar emerged as the top recommendation from a pool of 12 candidates.

• The selection process was conducted by the Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) panel, with Kumar endorsed for the position after a rigorous selection process.
 
• As Director (Refineries), Kumar will join the board of directors of Indian Oil, reporting directly to the Chairman. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Founded: 30 June 1959.
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi.
 
• Chairman: Shrikant Madhav Vaidya.

questions.question: Who was elected as the new Prime Minister of Vanuatu in February 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jotham Napat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Jotham Napat was elected as the new Prime Minister of Vanuatu on February 12, 2025.**
 
• He was nominated by former Prime Minister Charlot Salwai and elected unopposed.
 
• The election took place in the Vanuatu Parliament, where Ishmael Kalsakau confirmed no other nominations were **made.**
 
• Stephen Felix, a former judge and MP for Efate Rural Constituency, was elected Speaker of Parliament unopposed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jotham Napat, MP for Tanna, is the leader of the coalition government in Vanuatu.**
 
• **He leads a coalition consisting of the Leaders Party, Vanua’aku Party, Graon Mo Jastis Party, Reunification Movement for Change, and the Iauko Group.**
 
• **The Parliament also elected four deputy speakers, all unchallenged.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Vanuatu__

 __
 
• Location: South Pacific Ocean
 
• Comprises around 80 islands
 
• Capital: Port Vila
 
• Official Languages: Bislama, French, English
 
• Continent: Oceania
 
 
 
• Other Key Officials Elected__
 __
 
• **Speaker of Parliament:** Stephen Felix
 
• **First Deputy Speaker:** John William Timakata (Vanua’aku Party)
 
• **Second Deputy Speaker:** Macrellino Barthelemy (Malekula)
 
• **Third Deputy Speaker:** Paul Paolo (Graon Mo Jastis Pati, Malekula)
 
• **Fourth Deputy Speaker:** Camillo Ati (Iauko Group, Santo Rural)
 
 
 
• Recent Political Developments__
 
 
• Charlot Salwai, former Prime Minister, nominated Jotham Napat.
 
• The coalition government was formed with multiple parties.
 
• The election process was conducted smoothly without opposition.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Prime Minister of Lebanon in 2024, ending over two years of political stalemate?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nawaf Salam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lebanon has formed its first full-fledged government since 2022**, ending a prolonged political deadlock.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **President Joseph Aoun appointed Nawaf Salam as the new Prime Minister**, accepting the resignation of the former caretaker government.
 
• **Salam pledged to restore confidence between citizens and the state**, strengthen Lebanon’s ties with Arab nations and the international community, and implement key **economic and judicial reforms**.
 
• **He vowed to follow up on the ceasefire agreement with Israel**, ensuring Israeli forces withdraw from **Lebanese territory** and reconstructing war-damaged areas.
 
• **The new cabinet consists of 24 ministers, evenly split between Christian and Muslim sects**, reflecting Lebanon’s power-sharing system.
 
• **Lebanon remains in a severe economic crisis**, with failing banks, a collapsed electricity sector, and widespread poverty.
 
• **Salam’s appointment signals a shift away from Hezbollah-aligned leadership**, with the government seeking improved relations with **Saudi Arabia and Gulf nations**.
 
• **The U.S. has expressed opposition to Hezbollah’s involvement in the government**, but the group negotiated for Shiite representation.
 
• **Former army chief Aoun, elected as president in January, also supports state control over weapons**, indirectly challenging **Hezbollah’s armed influence**.
 
• **Tensions persist along Lebanon’s eastern border with Syria**, with clashes between **Lebanese clans and Syrian security forces** linked to former militant groups.

questions.question: Ashok Singh Thakur elected as Chairman of Indian National Trust for Art and Cultural Heritage (INTACH) in March 2025. When was INTACH formally constituted?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**27th January 1984**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Ashok Singh Thakur elected as Chairman of INTACH.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **AGM of INTACH** was held on **22nd March 2025** at the Head Office in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
**Ashok Singh Thakur** was elected as **Chairman** for a **3-year term**.

 
 
• 
 
**INTACH** was formally constituted on **27th January 1984** under the **Societies Registration Act (1860)**.

 
 
• 
 
INTACH’s **mandate** includes the preservation and conservation of the **environment**, **revitalization of intangible heritage**, and **fostering awareness** about India’s rich heritage.

 
 
• 
 
INTACH acts as a **cultural bank**, providing **financial** and **technical expertise** for the conservation of cultural, natural, and innovative resources.

 
 
• 
 
The **INTACH Charter** was adopted in **2004**, and INTACH is now revising it to make it **interdisciplinary**, encompassing all aspects of **heritage** — tangible, intangible, natural, and cultural.

questions.question: Who was elected as the President of Lebanon in January 2025, ending a two-year power vacuum?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Joseph Aoun.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Joseph Aoun, Lebanon's army chief, was elected as the President, ending a two-year power vacuum.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Joseph Aoun secured 99 votes in the 128-seat Lebanese parliament.**
 
• His election followed a ceasefire agreement amidst tensions between Israel and Hezbollah.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Lebanon__

 __
 
• Located in the Levant region of West Asia.
 
• Bordered by Syria, Israel, the Mediterranean Sea, and Cyprus.
 
• Capital: Beirut.
 
• Currency: Lebanese pound (LBP).
 
 
 
• Ceasefire Agreement__
 
 
• Follows 14 months of fighting between Israel and Hezbollah.
 
• Aimed at stabilizing the region and enabling reconstruction efforts in Lebanon.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4a/Nikos_Christodoulides_meets_with_Joseph_Aoun_%28cropped%29.jpg]

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new CEO of Unilever, succeeding Hein Schumacher? (Feb 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Fernando Fernandez**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Unilever CEO Hein Schumacher to step down in March 2025**, with **Fernando Fernandez (current CFO) appointed as successor**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Schumacher's tenure (since July 2023)** saw the **Growth Action Plan (GAP), a strategic reset, and financial progress**.
 
• **Chairman Ian Meakins praised Schumacher** for improving productivity and leading the separation of **Unilever’s ice cream division**.
 
• **Fernando Fernandez, appointed as CFO in January 2024**, previously led Unilever’s **Beauty & Wellbeing division** and held key roles in **Latin America, Brazil, and the Philippines**.
 
• **Srinivas Phatak (Deputy CFO & Group Controller) to serve as acting CFO** following Fernandez’s transition to CEO.
 
• Schumacher will **officially leave Unilever by May 31, 2025**.
